annotations.category_path: Veterans’ Disability Compensation and Pension Programs / Survivors / Average Annual Benefit (Dollars)
annotations.variable_note: 38 U.S. Code § 5120 directs that if the first day of the month occurs on a holiday or weekend, the Department of Veterans Affairs will make benefit payments on the preceding business day. That will result in one additional payment in fiscal years 2028 and 2033 and one fewer payment in fiscal years 2029 and 2035.
